class.name: HTMLCanvasElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML canvas element and its intrinsic pixel buffer.
class.description: Returned by DOM queries for [code]<canvas>[/code]. The default backing size is 300 by 150 pixels. CSS controls the displayed box independently from the backing image. Resizing either intrinsic dimension clears the image and resets the 2D context state. Backing storage is limited to 8192 pixels per dimension and 16 million pixels total.

method.name: get_context
method.description: Returns the cached 2D context for [code]2d[/code], or [code]null[/code] for unsupported context IDs or invalid handles.

method.name: get_image
method.description: Returns a copy of the backing RGBA image. A canvas without a created context returns a transparent image at its intrinsic size.

method.name: to_data_url
method.description: Encodes the backing image as a base64 data URL. PNG, JPEG, and WebP are supported. Unsupported MIME types fall back to PNG. Quality is clamped to [code]0.0[/code] through [code]1.0[/code] for lossy formats.

members.member: The intrinsic backing height in pixels. Assigning a new value clears the backing image and resets its context state.
The intrinsic backing width in pixels. Assigning a new value clears the backing image and resets its context state.
